Interactive .rsip v0.4 & .rsis Section Filter

Complete .rsip v0.4 Project, .rsis Suite & .rsii Include Sections
Section / Directive File Type Key Fields & Purpose
@include "file.rsii" .rsip / .rsii Inherits shared dialog workflows, [Requirements], or [Signing] blocks without losing comments on IDE save.
[Package] & [Install] .rsip (Required) Name, 3-part Version, Manufacturer, UpgradeCode, Architecture (x64|arm64), Scope, DefaultSubdir, MainExecutable.
[Feature.<Id>] .rsip (Optional) Title, Description, Level, Parent hierarchy, DisallowAbsent core lock, and AllowAdvertise for the MSI SelectionTree.
[Prerequisite.<Id>] .rsip (Optional) Preset (DotNet10Desktop, EdgeWebView2, VcRedist2022, Custom), Distribution (download|embedded|side-by-side), and RebootExitCodes.
[MergeModule.<Id>] .rsip (Optional) Merges 64-bit .msm SQL tables and CAB payloads into TargetRoot / Feature using native C++20 msi.dll + Cabinet.lib FDI.
[Component.<Id>] .rsip (Optional) Enforces Microsoft Component Rules: single TargetRoot/TargetSubdir, KeyPathKind (auto|file|registry|folder), KeyPathTarget, Permanent, NeverOverwrite.
[Folder.<Id>] .rsip (Optional) Creates destination subdirectories under any of 9 standard MSI roots via CreateFolder + automatic ICE64 RemoveFolder cleanup.
[Payload.<Id>] .rsip (1+ Required) Source (supports $(ARCH)), TargetRoot, TargetSubdir, optional explicit Component (or automatic 1-file UUIDv5 Component).
[FileAssociation.<Id>] .rsip (Optional) Extension, ProgId, Description, TargetFile, Verbs, ContentType, and Advertise (false = clean HKMU\Software\Classes; true = MSI SQL tables).
[UI], [MsiDialog.*] & [MsiControl.*] .rsip / .rsii WizardLayout (standard|aerowizard|autorun16x9), MsiDialogPreset (express_custom|minimal), plus custom 370×270 SQL dialogs spliced into msiexec!
[Suite] & [Project.<Id>] .rsis Suite Groups multiple .rsip projects with [Variable] tokens, Category filters, and ordered BuildOrder execution.

GitHub Actions & AI Agent CLI Quickstart

name: Package Windows x64 & ARM64 Installers
on: [push]
jobs:
  package:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Lint .rsis Suite & Microsoft Component Rules (JSON)
        run: .\bin\x64\instbuild.exe .\MySuite.rsis --validate --diagnostics=json
      - name: Compile .MSI, LZMS Setup.exe & VPAT 2.5 HTML5 Report
        run: .\bin\x64\instbuild.exe .\MySuite.rsis --with-vpat
